headword: {有言実行|ゆうげんじっこう}
gloss: practice what you preach; follow through on one's words

definitions.explanation: To actually do what one has declared one will do; to keep one's word and carry out one's stated intentions.

examples.japanese: {有言実行|ゆうげんじっこう}⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{信頼|しんらい}→信頼：03268_shinrai⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: People who practice what they preach are trusted.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{有言実行|ゆうげんじっこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: He's a man who follows through on his word.

examples.japanese: {有言実行|ゆうげんじっこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦モットー→モットー：29293_mottoo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: My motto is to always follow through on what I say.

notes:
FOUR-CHARACTER IDIOM (⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧):
{有言|ゆうげん} (stating/declaring) + ⟦{実行|じっこう}→実行：03274_jikkou⟧ (carrying out, execution)

ETYMOLOGY:
- {有|ゆう}: to have, to exist
- {言|げん}: words, to say
- {実|じつ}: reality, truth
- {行|こう}: action, to do

CONTRAST WITH ⟦{不言実行|ふげんじっこう}→不言実行：29294_fugenjikkou⟧:
⟦{不言実行|ふげんじっこう}→不言実行：29294_fugenjikkou⟧ (acting without speaking) is the opposite concept—doing things without announcing them beforehand. Both are considered virtues in different contexts.

USAGE:
Often used as a personal motto or to describe someone reliable who keeps their promises.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{言行一致|げんこういっち}→言行一致：29295_genkouicchi⟧: consistency between words and actions
- ⟦{約束|やくそく}→約束：01517_yakusoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧: to keep a promise
- {有言|ゆうげん}する: to declare, to state publicly
